Devlop Customs

Revolutionize the management of your customs processes with an integrated and fully digital solution.

Ready to optimize your operations and increase efficiency?

Contact us

What is Devlop Customs?

Devlop Customs is a specialized solution that ensures full management of customs processes, from the moment information is received to the customs clearance of goods.

With features tailored to legal and operational requirements, it enables the issuance of official documents in paper or digital format, ensuring compliance and agility at every stage of the process.

Additionally, the platform simplifies billing management and ensures automatic integration with accounting systems, reducing errors and increasing administrative efficiency.

Financial Management

Guarantees and Bonds
– Control of global guarantees for customs brokers and clients.
– Management of bank guarantees.

Invoicing
– Issuance of statements, invoices, debit and credit notes.
– Control of invoicing and automatic calculation of fees and customs duties.
– Invoicing by individual process or grouped.

Simplify Customs Management!

With the Devlop Customs solution, gain more control, more agility, and greater security. Contact us for a personalized demo.

Contact us now!

Reports and Statistics

Intrastat
– Processing of statistical declarations for intra-community transactions.
– Issuance of listings for clients and the National Statistics Institute.
– Export of files to IDEP.

Listings and Analysis
– Issuance of various reports for detailed analysis of process types.

Key Features

Import and Export Process Management

– Issuance of all necessary documentation for customs clearance, including simplified declarations.
– Creation of new processes by copying existing ones (full or partial).
– Management of Inward Processing Relief (IPR) regimes.

Electronic Process Handling

– STADA – Export: Electronic processing of export procedures (XML).
– STADA – Import: Electronic handling of import procedures.


New Computerized Transit System (NCTS)

– Full management of computerized customs transit.

Who is it for?

  • Customs Brokerage Companies

  • Freight forwarders offering customs document management

  • International logistics operators

  • Large exporters/importers with regular customs operations

Main Benefits

Full automation of customs documentation

Strict control of invoicing, guarantees, and bonds

Integration with official systems (STADA/NCTS) and accounting

Automatic generation of Intrastat declarations and statistics

Efficient management of complex and repetitive processes
